title: Figures 16-17: Casimir cavity with BHD photodiodes and LO field side view
description: Figure 16 is a color 3D diagram of two yellow parallel "Casimir plate" surfaces 1 µm apart with two "Photodiode" blocks between them and red arrows labeled "TE1 Coherent field (Local Oscillator)," captioned "Diagram of Casimir Cavity with BHD Photodiodes. (courtesy of P. Marecki)." Figure 17, titled "Side view:", is a grayscale field plot of x [µm] versus y [µm] from -1000 to 1000 marking positions of Photodiode x and Photodiode y, captioned "Experimental Setup of BHD Photodiodes and LO Field."
